hypothesis: Base Qwen3-8B can use a supplied QASPER paper ID to inspect the paper and return a source-grounded answer across answer types.
expected_signal: Five valid submissions; all cited spans come from the supplied paper; at least three of four answerable runs cite a gold evidence paragraph; the unanswerable run makes no unsupported factual claim.
decision_rule: Do not generate QASPER training trajectories if fewer than four runs submit valid JSON or fewer than three answerable runs reach gold evidence. Fix the prompt, known-paper navigation, or evidence access first.
